description.en: Postosuchus kirkpatricki inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Whole Postosuchus kirkpatricki. Weinbaum2011 Fig1 skull and author2013 Fig26 composite skeleton visually read. Deep compressed predator skull, high hindlimbs, shorter visible forelimbs, low paired dorsal osteoderms and full long tail. Two-hindfoot-supported pose is an ARTISTIC HYPOTHESIS only; biped/quadruped gait and foot contact remain scientifically uncertain per retained researcher note of2026 public abstract; no restricted fulltext read claimed. Nominal1m art scale not measured specimen. Skin, color, small teeth, toes, scute count and complete tail tip artistic.
